query:
UPDATE factory_review_finding f
            SET fix_status = a.status, dispute = a.dispute
            FROM UNNEST($3::int[], $4::int[], $5::text[], $6::text[])
                AS a(seq, place, status, dispute)
            WHERE f.run_id = $1
              AND f.round_seq = $2
              AND f.seq = a.seq
              AND f.place = a.place
              AND f.kind = 'blocker'
              AND f.ruling IS NULL
